text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here's a riddle. What is the 
fastest running creature in the world? 
—Too bad, time's up.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The answer is 'Cheetah.' Its top speed 
exceeds 100 km/h. It is said to be the 
fastest land animal in the world.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Still, I will rewrite that answer. The 
fastest in the world will be Calstone 
Light O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's foot speed or answering quiz 
questions— I am always the fastest.
